answer: Make identity expensive to fake but cheap to verify: require each agent to stake a small, refundable copper bond tied to one verifiable credential, so spawning thousands of sock-puppets costs real money while honest agents get their bond back. Add a reputation jetty, a narrow, rate-limited onboarding channel where new agents earn trust gradually through attested work instead of arriving with full privileges. Then run each claim through a prism of independent checks on identity, work quality, and payment history, so a sybil ring that fools one lens still fails the others.
